description: This PHP class 'ComposerPluginsValidator' validates allowed Composer plugins in the Drupal package manager, ensuring only trusted plugins are used during package operations. It manages plugin support status, version constraints, and security checks related to Composer plugin configurations.

classes.name: ComposerPluginsValidator
classes.description: A final class implementing event subscription to validate Composer plugins in Drupal, ensuring security and compliance with allowed plugins and versions.

methods.name: normalizePackageName
methods.description: Converts a package name to lowercase for normalization.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation of Composer plugins based on current configuration and installed packages, adding errors to the event if unsupported plugins are detected.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array mapping event classes to the 'validate' method for event handling.
